summary.title: Accessibility and VoiceOver improvements
changes: VoiceOver now speaks status, charts, and icon-only buttons in plain words.
Controls that previously required gestures can now be activated with VoiceOver actions.
Glucose bobble and charts now read a single, combined summary with value, trend, delta, and age.
Text scaling is bounded to prevent very large fonts from breaking layouts.
Glass panels and small UI chrome switch to opaque, higher-contrast fills when Reduce Transparency or Increase Contrast.
